info.title: Nitro PDF Services Public API
info.description: REST API for Nitro PDF Services: convert, transform, extract, and generate PDF documents, plus async job status/result retrieval. Machine-to-machine OAuth 2.0 client-credentials; short-lived bearer tokens. Assembled by API Evangelist from Nitro's published per-tool OpenAPI reference fragments; schemas preserved verbatim.

post.description:
Overlay a watermark image onto specific pages of a PDF document

This endpoint is polymorphic: the operation performed is selected by the request body. Documented tools on this endpoint: compress, delete, flatten, merge, ocr, optimize, protect, redact, rotate, set-properties, split, unprotect, watermark.

200.description:
Returns either JSON or binary output depending on the Accept header (defaults to JSON).
 JSON responses include a file URL for synchronous tasks or a job status for asynchronous tasks.

post.description:
Generate PDF document with filled form fields

This endpoint is polymorphic: the operation performed is selected by the request body. Documented tools on this endpoint: create-fillable-forms, fill-forms.

file.description: The source PDF document when using inline field values via `params.fields`. Use this parameter when providing form field values directly instead of a data file.

files.description: The source PDF and data file when using a data file. `files[0]` is the source PDF document (application/pdf). `files[1]` is the data file containing form field values (CSV, JSON, XFDF, or FDF format).

200.description:
Returns either JSON or binary output depending on the Accept header (defaults to JSON).
JSON responses include a file URL for synchronous tasks or a job status for asynchronous tasks.

post.summary: Extract Fillable Form Data from PDF
post.description:
Extract the data of a PDF's existing AcroForm — field names, current values, field types and positions — as JSON, XFDF, FDF, or CSV

This endpoint is polymorphic: the operation performed is selected by the request body. Documented tools on this endpoint: extract-fillable-form-data, extract-invoices, forms, get-properties, pii, smart-detect-form-fields, tables, text, text-box.

200.description:
Returns either JSON or binary output depending on the Accept header (defaults to JSON).
 JSON responses describe the extracted form-field data for synchronous tasks, or a job status for asynchronous tasks.

post.description:
Convert a PDF file to PDF/A archival format

This endpoint is polymorphic: the operation performed is selected by the request body. Documented tools on this endpoint: imgtopdf, misctopdf, mstopdf, pdfa, pdftoimg, pdftoms.

200.description:
Returns either JSON or binary output depending on the Accept header (defaults to JSON).
 JSON responses include a file URL for synchronous tasks or a job status for asynchronous tasks.

textBoxes.description: One result per query, in the same order as the request's `queries`.

text.description: The text captured by the group.

boxes.description: The bounding boxes covering the group, one per line of text.

producer.description: PDF document's producer or encoding software

creationDate.description: Document creation date in PDF date format

modDate.description: Document modification date in PDF date format

fields.description: Array of extracted form fields from the document

averageConfidence.description: Average confidence score for all form fields

name.description: The name of the form field.

value.description: The extracted value of the form field.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the form field extraction.

AcceptHeader.description:
Controls response format and behavior. See endpoint description above for detailed response combinations.
- `application/json`: Returns JSON response with operation result
- `application/octet-stream`: Returns binary file content 
- `*/*`: Defaults to JSON response

AcceptEventHeader.description:
Controls response format and behavior. See endpoint description above for detailed response combinations.
- `application/json`: Returns JSON response with operation result
- `application/event-stream`:  Enables Server-Sent Events for real-time updates 
- `*/*`: Defaults to JSON response

PreferHeader.description:
Controls synchronous vs asynchronous operation. See endpoint description above for behavior details.
- `respond-async`: Makes request asynchronous, returns job status for polling
- No value: Synchronous response

oneOf.description:
#### Remote file 
 JSON objects containing file URL and content type, sent with specific multipart encoding: `type` and `filename`. The playground **doesn't support** them. Plase test with an alternative tool (Ex: Postman). 

Example cURL file field for remote file:
```bash
--form 'file={
   "URL":"https://your-file.pdf",
   "contentType":"application/pdf"
}
;type=application/vnd.gonitro.url+json
;filename=https://your-file.pdf'
```

items.description: The files to process. They can be provided as a binary uploads or as a JSON with remote file references.

oneOf.description:
#### Binary files 
 Standard multipart file binary upload field

URL.description: URL of the remote file to process

contentType.description: The MIME type of the remote file

oneOf.description:
#### Remote files 
 JSON objects containing file URL and content type, sent with specific multipart encoding: `type` and `filename`. The playground **doesn't support** them. Plase test with an alternative tool (Ex: Postman). 

Example cURL for remote files:
```bash
--form 'files={
   "URL":"https://your-file-1.pdf",
   "contentType":"application/pdf"
}
;type=application/vnd.gonitro.url+json
;filename=https://your-file-1.pdf' \
--form 'files={
   "URL":"https://your-file-2.pdf",
   "contentType":"application/pdf"
}
;type=application/vnd.gonitro.url+json
;filename=https://your-file-2.pdf'
```

DeliverySingleFileOut.description:
This endpoint lets you supply your own URL to receive the single-file output. The URL may point to a custom API endpoint or a pre-signed S3 URL. 

 The HTTP method defaults to PUT, but you can change it based on your implementation needs via the `verb` parameter. You can also provide custom headers, such as authentication headers or any others required by your endpoint.

DeliveryMultiFileOut.description:
This endpoint lets you supply your own URLs to receive the multiple-file outputs. The URLs may point to a custom API endpoint or a pre-signed S3 URL. 

 The HTTP method defaults to PUT, but you can change it based on your implementation needs via the `verb` parameter. You can also provide custom headers, such as authentication headers or any others required by your endpoint.

result.description:
The result is returned as data in the same format as the original request's synchronous response type. 
 Transformations and Conversions return one or more files, while Extractions return a JSON object containing the requested data.

conformance.description: PDF/A conformance level. Levels ending in `a` (accessible) require the source PDF to be tagged; untagged PDFs submitted with an `a`-level conformance will return an error. Use `b` or `u` variants for general-purpose archiving.

imageQuality.description: Image compression quality during conversion. `1.0` preserves maximum quality; `0.01` applies maximum compression. Lower values reduce file size at the cost of image fidelity.

copyMetadata.description: When `true`, document metadata (author, creation date, title, etc.) is preserved in the output. When `false`, metadata is stripped.

pageIndices.description: Array of page indices to extract text from (0-based)

readingOrder.description:
Extract text in reading order (left-to-right, top-to-bottom) 
 Unordered extraction returns the same output each time for the same file.

queries.description: Array of queries to search for in the PDF file.

text.description: The text or regular expression to search for.

isRegex.description: Whether `text` should be treated as a regular expression.

regexFlags.description: Regex matching flags; only allowed when `isRegex` is `true`.

ID.description: A unique identifier for a PII detection group. Multiple individual PII entries can share the same ID, indicating they belong to the same group or type of PII.

text.description: The complete text block that contains PII. For instance, the full text of an address spaning multiple content boxes.

textPiece.description: The specific piece of text identified as PII inside a box.

pageIndex.description: Page index where the PII was found (0-based).

boundingBox.description: Bounding box coordinates in points [x, y, width, height]. Check the [Bounding Box Guideline](/build-nitro/bounding-box).

confidence.description: Confidence score for the PII detection.

PIIBoxes.description: Array of detected PII bounding boxes

PDFPasswordProtectionParams.description: PDF protection parameters. You must provide either ownerPassword, userPassword, or both. They cannot both be null.

ownerPassword.description: The PDF owner's password to overwrite permissions. 40 characters max. Nullable if `userPassword` is defined.

userPassword.description: The PDF user password. 40 characters max. Nullable if `ownerPassword` is defined.
User password to unlock the PDF

rotations.description: Array of page rotations to apply

pageIndices.description: Array of page index arrays - each sub-array represents pages for one output file
Array of page indices to delete (0-based)

producer.description: PDF document's producer or the encoding software

pageIndex.description: Zero-based page index to position a reaction box.

boundingBox.description:
An array of numbers in the format [x, y, w, h] that defines the redaction's bounding box on the page: 
 - `x, y` are the coordinates of the top-left corner, measured in points (pt). 
 - `w, h` are the width and height of the bounding box, also in points (pt). 

 For more information on calculating positions, see the [Bounding Box Guide](/build-nitro/bounding-box).

WatermarkParams.title: Watermark
WatermarkParams.description: Parameters controlling watermark placement, sizing, and appearance on each PDF page.

boundingBox.description: Bounding box coordinates `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` in PDF points. Defines the area where the watermark image will be placed.

opacity.description: Watermark transparency. `0.0` = fully transparent, `1.0` = fully opaque.

rotation.description: Rotation angle in degrees to apply to the watermark image.

pageIndices.description: Zero-based page indices where the watermark should be applied. If `null` or omitted, the watermark is applied to all pages. Negative values are rejected; out-of-range indices are ignored.

flip.description: Optionally mirror the watermark image horizontally, vertically, or both.

rotateWithPage.description: When true, the watermark rotates along with the page if the page itself has a rotation applied.

centerOnPage.description: When true, the watermark is centered on the page. `boundingBox` is still required. Also accepts `center_on_page`.

contentDepth.description: Controls whether the watermark renders above or below the existing page content. Values use underscores, not hyphens. Also accepts `content_depth`.

fitToPageWidth.description: When true, scales the watermark image to fit the page width. Requires `boundingBox` for vertical positioning unless `fitToPageHeight` is also true. Also accepts `fit_to_page_width`.

fitToPageHeight.description: When true, scales the watermark image to fit the page height. Requires `boundingBox` for horizontal positioning unless `fitToPageWidth` is also true. Also accepts `fit_to_page_height`.

profile.description: Optimization profile that determines how the PDF is compressed and restructured. Choose based on the intended use case: screen viewing, high-quality printing, long-term archiving, maximum file size reduction, or documents containing mixed raster content.

PDFCompressParams.title: Compress
PDFCompressParams.description: Compress has no parameters; it always targets the smallest file size. For control over the size/quality trade-off, use the Optimize operation and its `profile`.

language.description: Language of the text in the document. Selecting the correct language improves character recognition accuracy.

quality.description: Controls the trade-off between processing speed and recognition accuracy. `low` is fastest, `high` produces the most accurate results.

isOutputPDFEditable.description: When `true`, recognised text is rendered over the page image, making it editable. When `false` (default), text is placed behind the image, making the PDF searchable while preserving its visual appearance.

compressionLevel.description: Compression level applied to the output PDF. `low` retains the best image quality, `high` produces the smallest file size.

PDFVersion.description: PDF specification version for the output file. Defaults to `pdf17` (PDF 1.7) for the broadest compatibility.

pageIndices.description: Zero-based indices of the pages to process. When `null` or omitted, OCR is applied to all pages in the document.

strict.description: Controls validation behavior when filling form fields. When `true`, requests fail with 422 if the input contains unknown field names or omits required fields; when `false`, unrecognized fields are silently ignored and only matching fields are filled.

fields.description: Inline field name/value pairs to fill, as an alternative to supplying the values in a CSV, JSON, XFDF, or FDF data file.

field.description: Name of the PDF form field to fill.

value.description: Value to set for the field. May be a string, number, boolean, or null.

FormFieldDetection.description: A single detected form field. The same shape is returned by Smart Detect Form Fields and accepted by Create Fillable Forms.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based index of the page the field belongs to.

name.description: The name of the form field. Becomes the AcroForm field name.

boundingBox.description: The field's position and size in PDF points, as `[x, y, width, height]`.

value.description: Optional initial value for the field.

SmartDetectFormFieldsResponse.title: Sync - Form Fields
SmartDetectFormFieldsResponse.description: A flat list of detected form fields. Each field carries its own `pageIndex`. This is the exact payload you pass as `params` to the [Create Fillable Forms](https://developers.gonitro.com/docs/api-reference/platform/generations/create-fillable-forms) generations method.

formFields.description: The detected form fields, one entry per field.

CreateFillableFormsParams.title: Create Fillable Forms
CreateFillableFormsParams.description: A flat list of form fields to write into the PDF, each carrying its own `pageIndex`. This is the exact detected-fields payload returned by the [Smart Detect Form Fields](https://developers.gonitro.com/docs/api-reference/platform/extractions/smart-detect-form-fields) extraction method, which you typically pipe straight into this method with no transformation.

formFields.description: The form fields to create, one entry per field.

format.description:
Output format for the extracted form data.
- `json` (default): structured JSON with one `formFields` entry per form-field widget
- `xfdf`: Adobe XFDF form-data document of field name/value pairs
- `fdf`: Adobe FDF form-data document of field name/value pairs
- `csv`: CSV with columns `name,value,fieldType,pageIndex,x,y,width,height`, one row per widget

FillableFormField.description: A single form-field widget read from the PDF's existing AcroForm.

pageIndex.description: Zero-based index of the page the field widget is on.

name.description: The fully-qualified AcroForm field name. Radio-button groups produce one entry per widget, repeating the group name.

value.description: The field's current value. `""` when unfilled; check boxes report `"true"` or `"false"`.

boundingBox.description: The widget's position and size in PDF points, as `[x, y, width, height]`.

choices.description: The available options of a `ComboBox`/`ListBox` field, or a radio-button group's export values. `null` for other field types.

ExtractFillableFormDataResponse.title: Sync - Fillable Form Data
ExtractFillableFormDataResponse.description: A flat list of the form-field widgets in the PDF's existing AcroForm, with their names, current values, types, and positions. Empty when the PDF has no AcroForm.

formFields.description: The extracted form fields, one entry per widget.
